authority.provider: Ministry of Digital Affairs, Taiwan, CNS11643 Chinese Standard Interchange Code Full Character Database

visual_copybook.usage: independently rasterized topology comparison only; no reference outline, coordinate, or trace enters an image-generated glyph

policy.pass_definition: The exact requested scalar is present; visible Taiwan Traditional topology agrees with current CNS mapping and stroke-sequence structure; the glyph remains directly recognizable at native, 128, 64, and 32 px cell sizes; ink clears the grid; and no stray thorn, wrong hook, missing or extra semantic stroke is visible.
policy.reject_definition: Any uncertainty, simplified or incompatible variant, missing or extra semantic component, topology-changing join, wrong hook, unreadability at a reviewed size, grid contact, stray ink, or thorn-like defect is REJECT.
policy.raster_limit: A final raster establishes visible topology but cannot prove the temporal act of writing each official stroke.
policy.vectorization_limit: PASS permits controlled tracing of isolated dark authored ink only. Grid lines, near-white background variation, antialias halos, and CNS copybook outlines are forbidden geometry.
policy.descriptor_mutation: This audit does not modify source descriptors, approval metadata, or manifests.

method.resampling: Lanczos reduction of each complete isolated cell without ink-bbox fitting; nearest-neighbour enlargement was used only to inspect reduced or source pixels.
method.grid_detection: Exactly five long light-gray line groups per axis were detected by projection; no equal-grid fallback was used. Grid clearance is the minimum distance from a pixel darker than L=100 to the nearest detected cell boundary.
method.detached_speck_check: Eight-connected dark-ink components at L<100 were enumerated in every raw cell; no component smaller than 20 source pixels exists.
